Generate p01, inspect it at 900/360/250/180 px and in the centered 4:5 crop, then p02.

shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture, soft natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on clothing, badges, book spines and walls. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the person, both hands and everything the sentence depends on inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.full_body: The camera is at chest height a few steps back, with a clear, unobstructed view: the person's whole body from head to feet and the floor are visible, the face is fully visible and in sharp focus.

assets.item: Luis is tall. / He is tall. / Who is tall?

reference_file.observed_description: Luis (short dark curly hair, clean-shaven, warm medium-brown skin, friendly smile) in a navy crew-neck T-shirt with a white LUIS badge and khaki trousers stands in a courtyard doorway among potted plants, pointing to his badge and smiling to the left.

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Luis. Keep his face, short dark curly hair, clean-shaven face, warm medium-brown skin and build exactly. Create a new photograph inside a bright home with white walls and a light wooden floor. Luis is a very tall man of about 30. He walks toward the camera through an open interior doorway with a plain white door frame, and the top of the door frame is lower than the top of his head: he bends his head and neck forward and down so that his head passes just under the top of the frame, with one hand resting on the side of the frame. The whole door frame, including its top, is visible around him. He wears a plain navy crew-neck T-shirt with no badge, khaki chinos and navy sneakers, and smiles. Ducking under the doorway makes it obvious at a glance that he is tall.

assets.item: Sofia is short. / She is short.

reference_file.observed_description: Sofia (long curly dark hair to her shoulders, warm brown skin, bright smile) in a bright blue blazer over a white blouse, with a SOFIA badge, points to herself and holds a small Canada card at a busy community fair.

assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Sofia. Keep her face, warm brown skin and build exactly. Her long curly dark hair is pulled up into a neat high bun, so no hair falls on her shoulders or back. Create a new photograph in a bright, quiet neighborhood library with a plain white wall and a warm wooden floor. Sofia is a short adult woman of about 30 with normal adult proportions. A tall light-oak bookcase filled with books whose spines are plain solid colors without lettering stands against the wall in the center; its top shelf is far above her head. She stands with both feet on the top step of a small two-step wooden step stool, clearly visible under her feet, and even on the stool she stretches one arm fully up to take a red book from the top shelf. She wears her bright blue blazer over a white blouse, black trousers and flat black shoes, with no badge and no card, and smiles. The step stool makes it obvious at a glance that she is short: she needs it to reach the shelf.
